title_zh: 必要性檢定—資安與整合
method_en: The kept physical PBX is the risk baseline (plaintext SIP/UDP 5060, no TLS 1.3). Two coupled one-sided t-tests on the like-for-like IP alternatives; the joint H0 is rejected only if BOTH the security and integration legs reject.
method_zh: 以保留的實體 PBX 為風險基準（SIP UDP 5060 明文、不支援 TLS 1.3）。對等可替換的 IP 替代方案上做兩個耦合單尾 t 檢定；資安與整合兩面向皆拒絕時才拒絕聯合 H0。
hypothesis_a_en: (A) Security necessity — H0: mean security_score ≤ 3.0 (legacy plaintext PBX, no TLS 1.3); H1: > 3.0.
hypothesis_a_zh: (A) 資安必要性—H0：平均 security_score ≤ 3.0（舊式明文 PBX，不支援 TLS 1.3）；H1：> 3.0。
hypothesis_b_en: (B) Integration feasibility — H0: mean complexity ≥ 5 (Medium-High+); H1: < 5.
hypothesis_b_zh: (B) 整合可行性—H0：平均複雜度 ≥ 5（偏高）；H1：< 5。
population_note_en: Test population: 53 network-reachable (IP) alternatives — the like-for-like replacements for PBX signalling. The 78 physical/local-bus alternatives are controlled by isolation (mean score 3.72), not network crypto, and are reported separately.
population_note_zh: 檢定母體：53 個可連網（IP）替代方案，與 PBX 訊號等價可替換；另有 78 個實體／本地匯流排方案以隔離防護（平均分數 3.72），非網路加密，另行列示。
verdict_en: Replacing the kept plaintext PBX is a security upgrade and is integration-feasible
verdict_zh: 汰換保留的明文 PBX 屬資安升級且整合可行

baseline_risks.text_en: SIP signalling defaults to plaintext UDP 5060; INVITE/REGISTER and RTP media are readable on-path unless explicitly moved to TLS 5061 + SRTP.
baseline_risks.text_zh: SIP 預設以 UDP 5060 明文傳輸，除非改用 TLS 5061 + SRTP，否則 INVITE/REGISTER 與 RTP 媒體在路徑上可被讀取。

baseline_risks.text_en: Legacy IP-PBXs, analog adapters and older SIP phones support only plain RTP and pre-1.3 TLS (1.0/1.1) — i.e. no TLS 1.3. EOS/SOL-class units pass signalling in plaintext.
baseline_risks.text_zh: 舊型 IP-PBX、類比轉接器與舊 SIP 話機僅支援明文 RTP 與 1.3 以前的 TLS（1.0/1.1）—— 即不支援 TLS 1.3。EOS／SOL 等線路以明文傳訊。

baseline_risks.text_en: Exposed SIP ports are fingerprinted and brute-forced within minutes by free tools (SIPVicious); SS7/SMS interception is a known side-channel.
baseline_risks.text_zh: 暴露的 SIP 埠數分鐘內即被 SIPVicious 等免費工具指紋掃描與暴力破解；SS7／SMS 攔截為已知旁路。

integration_friction.text_en: Cross-vendor SIP breaks from OEM tweaks: proprietary header fields and non-RFC message sequences a carrier SBC won't handle by default.
integration_friction.text_zh: 跨廠商 SIP 因 OEM 各自微調而出問題：專有標頭欄位與非 RFC 訊息序列，運營商 SBC 預設無法處理。

integration_friction.text_en: Cisco CUCM requires documented per-PBX technotes for RFC-compliance issues in SIP call setup.
integration_friction.text_zh: 思科 CUCM 需逐型技術文件處理 SIP 呼叫建立的 RFC 相容性問題。

integration_friction.text_en: Panasonic cannot guarantee SIP-extension operation in all environments; legacy PBXs use proprietary closed architectures, making third-party integration costly — a bounded one-time bridging cost, not an end-state blocker.
integration_friction.text_zh: 松下無法保證所有環境下 SIP 分機運作；舊 PBX 採專有封閉架構，第三方整合成本高 —— 屬一次性橋接成本，非終態障礙。
